title: eza view
description: A declarative graph or ledger view, stored in one user database and exchanged over /api/v1/views. One schema covers both shapes: a create or PATCH payload (which omits the server-assigned fields) and the stored/exported wrapper (which carries all of them). `name`, `kind` and `definition` are required; `schema`, `slug`, `is_default`, `id`, `created_at` and `updated_at` are optional because the server assigns them when they are absent, and every stored/exported document includes them. The server decoder also fills omitted graph-definition fields with their documented defaults, so a minimal create payload can be smaller than the canonical document shape. Extensions v1 stores view definitions as data and never executes them.

schema.description: View definition schema version. Only version 1 is defined. Optional on create (the server writes 1); always present on a stored/exported wrapper.

id.description: Server-assigned row id. Optional on create (the server allocates it); always present on a stored/exported wrapper.

slug.description: Lowercase identifier used in URLs and as the view id. Optional on create (derived from the name when absent); always present on a stored/exported wrapper.

is_default.description: Default view for its owner and kind. At most one default per (owner, kind). Optional on create (defaults to false); present on a stored/exported wrapper.

definition.description: The declarative definition. Its shape depends on kind.

created_at.description: POSIX seconds. Server-assigned on create; always present on a stored/exported wrapper.

updated_at.description: POSIX seconds. Server-assigned; always present on a stored/exported wrapper.

query.description: Search expression. Same syntax as the q parameter of GET /api/v1/bookmarks.

hexColor.description: Hex colour, #rrggbb; hex digits are case-insensitive.

tags_shown.description: Show tag nodes in the neighbourhood.

local_depth.description: Neighbourhood depth around the focused record: 1 to 3, or null for the whole library. The seeded default graph view uses null.

sort.description: Ledger order. Same values as the sort parameter of GET /api/v1/bookmarks.
